text:
Type: black wooden swivel desk armchair
Use: working at a desk, dining; home office, study, dining room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid wood frame in a black stain, black metal swivel and height-adjustable column
Colors: matte black, black brown
Shape: curved top rail flowing into armrests, slatted spindle back, saddle-shaped seat, swivel column on four splayed wooden legs with cross stretchers, sturdy, medium visual weight
Feel: sturdy, crafted, classic, grounded
Goes with: dark or warm wood desks, white walls, brass or black accents; farmhouse, traditional or industrial home offices
